properties.evidence: foundations_walk (inference.rs:6562) and proof_chain_walk (inference.rs:6914) recurse once per step with no depth bound, at 528 and about 1,008 bytes a frame, on a 2 MiB tokio worker stack nobody sizes; gdb showed about 3,880 and 2,000 of those frames at the two overflows, and the same call passes on an 8 MiB stack. The truth evaluation beside them is bounded at 64 and graphalg already walks with explicit stacks, so these two walks are the ones left unbounded.
